Name: Slime Pet
Author: NoodleyFelix
Description:
Dialogue and sound effects are not changed, but your pet will become an adorable slime. If you use the optional "Generic Mod Config Menu" you can change which cats and dog breeds are replaced with the slime by changing the variable to "Slime"

otherwise you can change the config file after loading the mod once. by default it will look like 

{
  "Slime Pet": "true",
  "Orange Cat": "Cat",
  "Grey Cat": "Cat",
  "Yellow Cat": "Cat",
  "White Cat": "Cat",
  "Black Cat": "Cat",
  "Iridium Cat": "Cat",
  "Yellow Dog": "Dog",
  "Yellow and Brown Dog": "Dog",
  "Brown Earred Dog": "Dog",
  "Grey Dog": "Dog",
  "Brown Dog": "Dog",
  "Iridium Dog": "Dog"
}

change the value from "Cat" or "Dog" to "Slime" and that pet will be replaced with the slime.
hats don't work properly as the location of the hat will still go wherever it was for the animal you replaced with slimes meaning the hats often floating to the side. this likely wont get fixed because i made this mod as a joke with a friend and haven't had the drive to look back into updating it. 

As of 1.2 update you can now have different color slimes. Each color is treated as a unique pet though so if you get a red slime you cant change that one to an orange slime, you would need to adopt a new slime. 
You can have multiple slimes of different color in one save. simply go to the mod menu and select all the slime colors to make them all available to adopt from start or adopt from Marnie.
